text: 2.73 Conversion of Shipping Bill from one Scheme to another Customs Authorities, after recording reasons in writing, permit conversion of any scheme-shipping bill on which benefit of that scheme has not been availed, in accordance with the Regulations under Customs Act, 1962, and exporter would be entitled to benefit under scheme in which shipment is subsequently converted.
